news.title: No independent directors
news.body: No new directors have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: No new directors. 2 experienced directors. 1 highly experienced director. No independent directors (3 non-independent directors). CEO & Director Trupti Pandit was the last director to join the board, commencing their role in 2021. The following issues are considered to be risks according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model: Lack of independent directors. Insufficient board refreshment.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.03 (vs ₹0.15 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.03 (up from ₹0.15 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹4.97m (up 44% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹94.0k (up ₹570.0k from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 1.9% (up from net loss in 3Q 2025). The move to profitability was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 122% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 58% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.01 (vs ₹0.097 loss in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.01 (up from ₹0.097 loss in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹3.20m (down 9.0% from 2Q 2025). Net income: ₹33.0k (up ₹345.0k from 2Q 2025). Profit margin: 1.0% (up from net loss in 2Q 2025). The move to profitability was driven by lower expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 138% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 58% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.
